title: Influence of physicochemical factors on the transport behavior of polyethylene nanoplastics in black soil and brown earth
content:

Polyethylene nanoplastics (PENPs) accumulate in soil, presenting significant environmental risks. However, research on the transport behavior of PENPs in soils remains limited. In this study, we employed saturated column experiments...
